subject: Mitochondria hand protons to lysosomes: a new acidification pathway that fails with age
script: From Agewell Brief: Mitochondria hand protons to lysosomes: a new acidification pathway that fails with age. A conserved mechanism shows mitochondrial proton export via membrane contacts drives lysosomal acidification; aging disrupts this coupling, but engineered links restore it. Mitochondria-lysosome contacts transfer protons to acidify lysosomes. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
